designationHistory.indexText: Congress established Crab Orchard National Wildlife Refuge in southern Illinois by transferring the Crab Orchard Creek project lands and the former Illinois Ordnance Plant to the Fish and Wildlife Service, for wildlife conservation, agriculture, industry and recreation.
designationHistory.note: All give August 5, 1947; the FR notice names Public Law 80-361. The statute text itself was not read. Signer is the President in office on that date.
